Query

Relational databases

Managed SQL databases and high-performance cloud-native relational engines.

1. Core Concept

  • RDS removes the pain of patching and backing up traditional SQL databases. Aurora is a re-engineered, cloud-native engine that abstracts storage from compute for extreme performance and scaling.

2. Key Services & Features

  • Amazon RDS:
    • Supports Postgres, MySQL, MariaDB, Oracle, SQL Server.
    • Multi-AZ provides a synchronous standby in another AZ for automatic failover.
    • Read Replicas provide asynchronous copies to scale read traffic.
  • Amazon Aurora:
    • Compatible with Postgres and MySQL.
    • Storage automatically grows in 10GB increments up to 128TB.
    • Data is replicated 6 ways across 3 AZs automatically.
    • Supports up to 15 Read Replicas (RDS only supports 5).
  • Aurora Global Database:
    • Cross-region replication with sub-second latency.
    • Perfect for global reads and disaster recovery.

3. Architecture Rules

  • Multi-AZ is for Disaster Recovery (availability). Read Replicas are for Performance (scaling).
  • You cannot encrypt an existing unencrypted RDS instance directly; you must snapshot it, copy the snapshot as encrypted, and restore.

4. Scenarios & Use Cases

  • A heavily read-intensive SQL application is overwhelming the primary database.
    • Choose: Add RDS Read Replicas and point reporting/read queries to them.
    • Why: It offloads read pressure from the primary instance.
  • An enterprise requires a MySQL database that scales instantly, survives an AZ failure automatically, and supports rapid failover.
    • Choose: Amazon Aurora.
    • Why: Its 6-way storage replication across 3 AZs and rapid failover mechanism outperforms standard RDS.
